note.title: Note
note.description: key is name of section, value is markdown content

AIVisitNote.title: AIVisitNote
AIVisitNote.description:
This represents the note summary for a single specific note schema. A given appointment will have multiple
AI visit notes.

Generated versions are retained. Exactly one version per appointment and
schema is current; prior outputs are marked with supersession metadata and
remain available for audited administrative recovery.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: total length of the transcript, in seconds

AIVisitTranscript.title: AIVisitTranscript
AIVisitTranscript.description:
Contents of the note are persisted for a long period of time and then eventually deleted.

We use soft deletion so we have a clear idea of when the note was deleted.

created_by_system.title: Created By System
created_by_system.description: the system the appointment was created by. API, UI, etc

external_id.title: External Id
external_id.description: external ID of the appointment in acuity, or another external system

appointment_name.title: Appointment Name
appointment_name.description: a couple words about the appointment

Appointment.title: Appointment
Appointment.description: Represents an appointment with a patient from accuity

note_type.title: Note Type
note_type.description: user generated name of the note type

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: key is field name, value is instruction

DoctorNoteSchema.title: DoctorNoteSchema
DoctorNoteSchema.description: A description of the fields required for a specific note type and instructions on what information goes in each field

cps_role.title: Cps Role
cps_role.description: Control Preferences Scale lineage: active | collaborative | passive.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Which read produced this: enacted (visit) or preferred (intake).

gap_decision_control.title: Gap Decision Control
gap_decision_control.description: enacted minus preferred on the decision-control axis.

EngagementRole.title: EngagementRole
EngagementRole.description:
A communication-role estimate for one visit transcript (engagement engine v2).

Reads the patient's *enacted* communication style from the visit transcript and
maps it to a Control Preferences Scale role (Self-Directed / Collaborative /
Directed). This is a decision-support communication aid, NOT a diagnosis or a
personality assessment. One row per scored transcript.

record_ref.title: Record Ref
record_ref.description: Opaque, short-lived, authenticated grant bound to the Clerk actor and current doctor/appointment/patient scope. It is not an EHR patient identifier and clients must not parse it.

OpenSandboxRecord.title: OpenSandboxRecord
OpenSandboxRecord.description: Opaque, short-lived record grant; never a vendor patient identifier.

Patient.title: Patient
Patient.description:
Represents a patient in the system. This to simply help a doctor to find a transcript or intake.

This is not perfect:

- Doctors will end up having patients with the same name
- Patient name could be entered in multiple different ways

Fixing this is left as an exercise to the reader.

Terminology.title: Terminology
Terminology.description:
Role-label pair used everywhere the app names the provider/patient
relationship (UI, generated notes, intake language). Add new pairs here
and to the frontend label catalog; never scatter per-surface overrides.
